body.x: BURG(www.burgsmartwatch.com) displayed a variety of 'BURG' watch phone at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Combining a mobile phone with a wristwatch, the BURG SmartWatch enables to make and take calls, send and receive SMS messages, listen to music, take photos, record videos and access most of phone’s functions without having to carry any device around.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
